search_log: Wikipedia 'Visual Basic (classic)' article image list: found non-free local file 'Visual Basic 6.0 on Windows XP.png' (alternate candidate); other images are logos, VB-DOS, a portrait, and small non-IDE screenshots.

Commons full-text file search for 'Visual Basic 6', 'VB6', 'Visual Basic 6.0', 'Visual Basic IDE', 'Visual Basic screenshot', plus Category:Visual Basic. No VB6 IDE screenshot found. Nearest: 'Hello World! in Visual Basic (classic).png' (185x185 message box), 'Form vide VB.JPG' (325x247 empty form, credited 'Visual Basic 10'), 'Visual Basic function.PNG' (code editor, version unstated), 'Package-and-deployment.png' and 'Setup-installer-vb6-herman-mas.png' (deployment wizard, not IDE), 'Vb6.png' and 'Ubuntu 10.04 vb6.png' (descriptions say VirtualBox/sidux settings). Metadata only; these were rejected on subject/size/version grounds.
